sample_events.title: Downtown Hackensack ELF CON Bar Crawl
Thanksgiving Eve Bash - Latin Social
Singles Night 35+

sources.notes: Important quirk: Eventbrite's category pages for a Bergen town (e.g. /d/nj--hackensack/nightlife/ or /parties/) returned 20 of 20 New York City events. Putting the town in the keyword fixes it: /d/nj--<town>/<town>-nj-dj/, -party/, -latin/, -new-years-eve/. A partial sweep today (53 searches across 29 towns) returned 165 distinct Bergen events, roughly a quarter of them nightlife, singles, comedy or dance. Each results page carries a JSON-LD ItemList, so it can be parsed without a browser; pace requests about 9 seconds apart or it returns HTTP 429. Organizer pages (/o/<id>) embed their upcoming events in __NEXT_DATA__.

gaps: Instagram profiles could not be opened without login, so most venue DJ lineups here rest on search-engine snippets of individual posts. Handles confirmed from a venue's own website: @williamscenternj, @theroosevelt356, @thecraftsmannj, @czenenglewood, @lifeafterrestaurant, @havanadc1, @soundillusiondjs_frankie_d, @the_salsa_connexion. Handles NOT confirmed: Midland Brew House, Cigarro, SideBar Hackensack, Lefkes at The Modern, Portobello, Nikki's, The Green Lounge, Taverna Veranda, Tavern 61, Dream360 (@dream360nj per an article), Thursday New Jersey.

No Bergen-based promoter running a standing 30+/40+ or 'grown and sexy' night was found. The closest are DAYSHIFT (touring, about every two months at the Williams Center, no future date posted), CZEN and Life After (venue-run R&B/Caribbean nights) and The Roosevelt / Dominick's / Portobello / Mason Jar disco-freestyle DJ nights.

Freestyle: no Bergen freestyle party with a future date. bergenPAC's annual Freestyle Flashback was Jan 17, 2026 (2027 date not found); Hot Night Events' parties are in West Orange, Totowa and Seaside. A site:instagram.com freestyle search for Bergen towns returned nothing.

Korean nightlife in Fort Lee / Palisades Park: only always-open pochas and karaoke lounges surfaced (Soosanghan, Crazy Pocha, Pocha Baekjubu, Mu:i). No club-style promoter, DJ residency or event calendar was found; it likely lives on KakaoTalk/Instagram in Korean.
Hookah lounges with DJ nights: only The Green Lounge (address disputed) surfaced. Nothing confirmed for Hackensack, Lodi, Garfield or Fairview.

Hotel bars and banquet halls: no public singles dance or DJ night found at the Hilton Hasbrouck Heights, Teaneck Marriott, Sheraton/DoubleTree Mahwah, The Elan (Lodi), The Venetian (Garfield), The Fiesta (Wood-Ridge) or Biagio's (Paramus). Only The Graycliff dinner show turned up. Their own sites were not individually checked.

Latin nights in Hackensack (Noches de Colombia Fridays, Margaritas Bar Thursday salsa at 252 Main St, El Alazan Latin Night, Al Chile at 187 Hackensack St) are snippet-level leads with no confirmed dates; Al Chile's town was not confirmed. Don Coqui Edgewater's Friday/Saturday lounge DJ is already in our data.

Leads not verified enough to list as sources: La Terrazza Ridgewood 'Rooftop Social' Thursdays with a DJ (old post, seasonal); a restaurant at 91 W Clinton Ave, Tenafly with DJ sets Friday and Saturday; a restaurant at 2191 Fletcher Ave, Fort Lee with a live DJ Thursdays 7-11 PM; Invito / Wyckoff Tavern Saturday DJs; LT Bar & Grill 'Catch Wednesdays' ladies night at The Shops at Riverside (old article); Kid Rip's Thanksgiving Eve with DJ Big Ant (town unknown); 'Metropolitan Social Club' promoter nights at 190 River Rd, Edgewater (Dembow vs Trap with DJ Mega Jay and DJ Ricky, June 27, 2026).

Ticketing platforms that could not be read: Resident Advisor (ra.co/events/us/newjersey, HTTP 403), Bandsintown city page (403), Posh (header only), American Dream events page (JavaScript only). Tickeri's Tri-State page showed only New York on page 1 of 43. Dice, Shotgun, Partiful, Ticketleap and Tixr were not searched. TicketWeb works but only through the Williams Center calendar.

Silent discos, paint-and-sip late nights: nothing current in Bergen (a 2025 silent disco day party at The Hive Lounge / Dream Bar in American Dream was the only hit; an adult paint event in Garfield was skipped as explicit).

Facebook: group pages returned only name, member count and a post stub without login. No active public Bergen-specific nightlife, over-30 or freestyle group was confirmed; a general Bergen moms group (8.7K) had a 'girls night out with DJ' thread, which suggests recommendations happen in mom/town groups rather than nightlife groups.

Thanksgiving Eve (Wed Nov 25) is confirmed with a DJ at The Roosevelt (DJ Anthony Pags), The Craftsman (DJ Chaos, 9 PM-2 AM) and as a Latin social in Ridgefield Park; Midland Brew House, SideBar, Tavern 61, Viva Margarita Hackensack and Shannon Rose Ramsey are snippet-level or last-year only. New Year's Eve is confirmed only at Shannon Rose Ramsey (Eventbrite), The Craftsman (Resy package) and Midland Brew House; nothing yet for Fort Lee, Edgewater or the Meadowlands.
